processes.name: Source-of-Truth Controller
processes.purpose: Maintain provenance, freshness and trust status for every decision-critical metric.
rules: Every critical metric must have a declared primary source.
A conflict between primary and secondary sources is surfaced, never silently overwritten.
Stale or conflicted financial data cannot trigger autonomous financial actions.

processes.name: AI Contract Gate
processes.purpose: Block AI processes from production until the mandatory AI Process Contract is valid.
rules: Missing required contract fields means blocked.
Cost, benefit metric and shutdown condition are mandatory.

processes.name: Experiment Operator
processes.purpose: Convert ideas and major changes into bounded experiments before full implementation.
rules: No SCALE decision without a predefined success metric.
Budget and time limits must exist before test start.
KILL is the default when evidence is insufficient after the agreed limit.

processes.name: Revenue Recovery Agent
processes.purpose: Find and prioritize recoverable revenue from unpaid, stalled or forgotten commercial opportunities.
rules: Only verified source data may enter the recovery queue.
Every recovery item must have an amount or expected value and a next action.
Customer communication requires channel permission and must respect opt-out status.

processes.name: SOP Compiler / Reuse Broker
processes.purpose: Turn accepted repeatable work into reusable operating knowledge and prefer reuse over re-solving.
rules: Only accepted work can become a canonical SOP.
Before starting similar work, search the SOP library first.
A reused SOP must retain version and source-result traceability.
Failed or obsolete SOPs are deprecated, not silently overwritten.
